title: Dev environment: install Flutter SDK + Xvfb screenshot loop
description: Install Flutter SDK (~2GB) on dev machine. Verify flutter doctor passes for Linux desktop and web targets. Set up visual feedback loop: Xvfb virtual display + Playwright screenshots. Test with flutter create + flutter run -d linux under Xvfb, screenshot with Playwright, verify Claude can see the rendered output. This is the foundation for all Flutter GUI iteration.
